content: For the future work, firstly, we are going to expand the dataset using the proposed method continually. Secondly, we will focus on solving the problem of proper noun translation and improve the translation system according to the features of ancient Chinese translation. Finally, we plan to introduce some techniques of statistical translation into neural machine translation to improve the performance.
